title: Nehru Science Centre Quiz
summary: Rotary Club of Bombay Queen City participated in an educational quiz competition organised at Nehru Science Centre, Mumbai, with students from 150 schools out of approximately 2,000 schools.
description: Rotary Club of Bombay Queen City participated in an educational quiz competition organised at Nehru Science Centre, Mumbai, with students from 150 schools out of approximately 2,000 schools. The initiative aimed to encourage scientific curiosity, enhance students’ knowledge, and promote logical thinking and healthy competition among young learners. The quiz provided students with an opportunity to showcase their knowledge, learn new concepts, and develop confidence while fostering an interest in science and education.
location: Nehru Science Center, Worli, MUMBAI, Maharashtra
